decisions.decision: Nebo's own rendered map replaces (not supplements) the interactive PostMiniMap/VoyageMap wherever Nebo data exists, site-wide

decisions.decision: Nebo map images extracted via PyMuPDF's native embedded-image pull (2480x2400), not PDF-page rasterization
decisions.rationale: matches the PDF's actual source resolution, no rasterization softening; legend reproduced as CSS since it isn't part of the embedded image

decisions.decision: Duplicate Nebo screenshots pasted into original 2022-era post bodies were removed only after individual visual verification via contact-sheet review of all 94 candidate posts, not by blindly trusting the 'last image' pattern
decisions.rationale: the pattern held for the 2022 season but broke down completely from mid-2023 on, where most posts' last images are real photos — blind removal would have deleted real content

context_notes: This was an extended, almost entirely site-polish session layered on top of an already-paused Phase 6 — not phase-plan work, so no phase directory was touched. Paused specifically because of context exhaustion (75%+), not because of any blocker or incomplete task — every commit in this session left the site in a fully working, build-verified state. One real incident worth knowing about if similar bulk-MDX edits are needed again: a mechanical regex removal of <VoyageStats /> tags from 361 post bodies silently broke MDX compilation in 224 of them by collapsing the blank line MDX requires between a trailing import block and following JSX — the build failure gave no filename, and had to be found via binary-search bisection (moving files out to /tmp in halves) rather than grep pattern-matching, which is worth remembering as a diagnostic technique, not just the specific bug.
